document.title: Which rendering contract do we adopt for the shared pieces?

sections.markdown: The choice turns on upkeep and consistency. See the [shared notes](https://example.com/notes) for background.

sections.question: Which rendering contract do we adopt for the shared pieces?
sections.context: Every screen keeps its own rendering path today, and small differences grow with each release. A shared contract lets every team ship from plain data while the design system owns layout and tone.
sections.recommendedAnswer: Adopt the shared contract because it keeps every screen consistent with the least upkeep.

options.label: Adopt the shared contract
options.consequence: One contract to keep, and no drift across screens.

options.label: Keep separate rendering paths
options.consequence: Each team keeps its own upkeep and its own drift.

sections.statement: The team adopts the shared contract for all new screens.

readability.ownerRequestQuote: Pick one shared way to render interface pieces from plain data.
readability.stakes: The choice decides how much effort the team spends keeping every screen consistent.
